detections.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things.
detections.summary: As an analogy for getting out of debt, co-host says a 350-400 pound person must shock their system with extreme measures like throwing out all junk food before easing up later.

verification_candidates.claim_text: People weighing 350 to 400 pounds who want to lose weight need to start with extreme measures, such as cutting out all junk food for a period, before moderating later.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: if you're 350, 400 pounds, and you want to lose weight, you have to shock your system by doing extreme things.
verification_candidates.rationale: A claim about what weight-loss approach works for people with severe obesity, though offered as an analogy.
